column1: # Slovak glossary. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. No native speaker has reviewed it.
# Same columns as en.tsv; term holds the Slovak forms, separated by " | ". Follows the D3 terms (approved, not merged). Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.
# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until en.tsv drops them. D3's new rows wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/sk.tsv: the loader refuses an id en.tsv lacks.
# Matching: a form inflects only if it ends in a plain vowel (a e i o u y á é í ó ú; not ý, ô, ä) with a stem of five letters or more, so other forms are listed.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would swap the setting and the measured value.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), rides_tile_max_speed, and main_speed_* if they arrive first. Read their English by today's meaning; they stay English (council verdict fallback). rides_tile_max_speed says Max speed but is a measured value: if it is drafted before D3 anyway, it is Najv. na jazde, never Max. rýchlosť.
